title: Convergence of entropy-stable continuous summation-by-parts discretizations of symmetric hyperbolic conservation laws
summary: The Lax equivalence theorem guarantees convergence of stable and consistent discretizations for linear hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs). For nonlinear problems, however, stability and consistency alone do not generally guarantee convergence, even for smooth solutions, and existing convergence results typically rely either on projection-based error decompositions or on linearization arguments that do not directly extend to entropy-stable split-form discretizations.
